notice: All people, issuers, identifiers, credentials and statuses below are fictional fixtures for controlled testing. These are not real university or employer records.

scenarios.title: Official registry match
scenarios.risk_note: Positive control; all evidence dimensions are satisfied.

scenarios.title: Credential content modified
scenarios.risk_note: Integrity mismatch should be treated as an alteration signal.

scenarios.title: Hash matches but issuer is unknown
scenarios.risk_note: Demonstrates false assurance from equating hash match with authenticity.

scenarios.title: No record returned by registry
scenarios.risk_note: Absence from a particular repository is not proof of forgery.

scenarios.title: Verification source unavailable
scenarios.risk_note: A hash match cannot compensate for unavailable issuer/status evidence.

scenarios.title: Credential revoked
scenarios.risk_note: Integrity may pass while current credential status is not valid.

scenarios.title: Credential belongs to another subject
scenarios.risk_note: Valid content and issuer do not prove that the applicant is the subject.

scenarios.title: Student consent pending
scenarios.risk_note: The workflow must wait or request consent rather than infer fraud.

scenarios.title: Credential expired
scenarios.risk_note: A matching hash alone says nothing about current validity.

scenarios.title: Issuer authenticated, status endpoint unavailable
scenarios.risk_note: Report what was verified and what remains unknown.
